title: Mimì è tanto malata!
subtitle: Rodolfo tells Marcello that Mimì is dying and he is too poor to save her, while she listens in hiding until her coughing gives her away, La bohème, Act 3

tempos.text: I tempo ma agitando un poco

passages.label: Mimì è tanto malata: Rodolfo's confession begins (Lento triste, (21)); Mimì, hidden: Che vuol dire?
Una terribil tosse (Sostenuto molto); Mimì: Ahimè, morire?!
La mia stanza è una tana squallida ((22)): the cold room, his remorse; Mimì: O mia vita!
Mimì di serra è fiore ((23), I tempo ma agitando un poco): love is not enough; Mimì: È finita!
Her coughing gives her away: Chè?! Mimì! Tu qui?; Vien là nel tepor!; No, quel tanfo mi soffoca! ((24))
Musetta laughs in the tavern (Allegretto mosso, (25)): Marcello runs in; Mimì: Addio.

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)
licences.author: Luigi Illica (1857–1919) and Giuseppe Giacosa (1847–1906)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 198-205 (from the last bar of page 198, Rodolfo's upbeat "Mi-" (tristamente), to the end of page 205, before figure (26), 60 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. The piano's bars 54-55, printed in 3/4 against the singers' 9/8 (the voice's dotted crotchet = the piano's crotchet), are written into the 9/8 bars. Tempo from the printed metronome marks Lento triste ♩ = 48 at figure (21) (bar 2) and Sostenuto molto ♩ = 40 (bar 8), the I tempo at figure (23) and the printed Lo stesso movimento relations (bars 43 and 48, ♪ = ♩); the agitando un poco, Sostenendo and Allegretto mosso are values chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
